launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.1.1: input + overlay bugfix pack - home screen buttons no longer go dead after navigating, the Multiplayer Add Server / Direct Connect dialogs now open centered and visible, right-click menus stay in place. New Badlion-style home screen (navy sidebar, account chip), light-blue colour design, and Singleplayer / Multiplayer / Accounts / Cosmetics render in centered size-capped windows so fullscreen and 4K never stretch the UI. The non-classic mod menu gains a Settings tab with the Classic Mod Menu switch (classic stays the default).
